messages:
Leah Kim: Thanks everyone for the all-hands — opening this live thread for tactical follow-ups about positioning and the roadmap. Drop short Qs and we'll answer.
Carmen Li: Quick ask: when we say 'unified runtime' in customer decks, what is the defensible moat vs someone running a managed endpoint + caching themselves?
Leah Kim: Good point. Moat = integration across routing, KV/prefix caching, model-variant fallbacks, and compile-time kernel selection tuned for our model catalog. It's not just one piece; it's the end-to-end operational predictability across hosted/dedicated/private.
Vikram Patel: SLA nuance: will enterprise SLAs include financial penalties or credits? Customers are asking during contract talks.
Leah Kim: Initial Dedicated SLAs will be credits for measured downtime. We'll consider penalty tiers later, but first we want predictable SLOs and observability that make credits rare. Legal + Finance drafting standard language now.
Noah Reed: On benchmarks — do we publish third-party, independent perf reports or keep internal labs? Sales asks for neutral data for procurement.
Leah Kim: We'll commission an independent perf report for top use cases (chat gen, embeddings at scale) and publish an executive summary. PMM to share timeline.
Sasha Ivanov: Partnerships question: will we push certified infra partners for Dedicated/Private (e.g., specific bare-metal partners)? What's the partner play?
Leah Kim: Yes — partner certification is a priority for private deployments. Certified partner list will be in the marketplace; partnership team is starting with two regional infra partners for EMEA and APAC.
Carmen Li: Marketing nuance: public messaging should avoid naming competitors explicitly, right? But SDRs need a quick rebuttal doc.
Leah Kim: Correct — public: capability-led. Sales: private battlecard with direct comparisons and suggested rebuttals. We'll circulate the battlecard by EOD Friday.
Vikram Patel: Roadmap ask: are we gating Private region work behind Optimize and Dedicated scaling, or running in parallel?
Leah Kim: Parallel with prioritized capacity: Optimize -> Dedicated scale -> Private GA, but certain private pilots will run earlier for strategic customers. We'll publish a one-line roadmap table so teams can plan.
Noah Reed: Any changes to free-tier / trial behavior that impacts PLG funnel? Heard a rumor about token caps.
Leah Kim: No changes to free trial this quarter. We may tweak quotas in experiments but will announce before rollout.
Sasha Ivanov: Security/compliance ask: will we fast-track SOC2 + ISO stuff for Private customers?
Leah Kim: SOC2 in progress; ISO assessment scoped for this year. Private customers will get prioritized evidence packages for sales cycles.
allhands-bot: Slides + recording: https://redwood.slides/all-hands/1776002468
Carmen Li: Thanks — can PMM drop the battlecard + the one-line roadmap here when ready?
Leah Kim: Yes — battlecard and roadmap table by Friday. I'll also add a short FAQ on "what constitutes the moat" for sales and product folks. Appreciate the focused questions. :rocket:
